slides.title: How Artificial Intelligence is Transforming Data Analysis
slides.subtitle: Dr. Sheik M. Isaacs, LSSBB, CSM, CSPO, CIMP 💻 on LinkedIn
slides.description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is revolutionizing the world as we know it, and one of the key areas where its impact is truly transformative is in data analysis. The ability of AI to process vast amounts of data at unprecedented speeds and with enhanced accuracy has unlocked a new era of insights and opportunities across various industries. In this article, will briefly answer the following, what is analytics, what is AI analytics, what’s the difference between AI & Traditional Analytics and briefly discuss what are some Business Use Cases of AI analytics. What is Analytics: Analytics involves the identification, interpretation, and communication of significant data patterns. Data analysts analyze intricate datasets to spot trends, while business analysts concentrate on grasping business requirements and offering strategic advice based on data. The four categories of data analytics include descriptive, diagnostic, prescriptive, and predictive. Descriptive Analytics: Serving as the foundation of data insights, descriptive analytics reveals "what happened" by interpreting historical data to glean insights into a business's evolution, according to Investopedia. This analytical approach paints a comprehensive picture of a business's performance, often complementing predictive and prescriptive analytics. Key insights include year-over-year comparisons, user volume, and revenue per subscriber. Diagnostic Analytics: Focused on uncovering the "why" behind occurrences, diagnostic analytics employs techniques such as drill-down, data discovery, data mining, and correlations. Through this method, companies pinpoint behavioral patterns and establish profound connections within their data. Predictive Analytics: Businesses utilize predictive analytics to foresee future trends and anticipate forthcoming events. By using existing data, modeling techniques, and statistical modeling, organizations can generate informed predictions about performance and future outcomes. Predictive models prove particularly valuable to marketing and insurance companies as they strive to make proactive decisions based on future projections. Key processes in predictive analytics encompass decision trees, neural networks, and regression models. Prescriptive Analytics: Operating on AI systems, prescriptive analytics empowers companies to make strategic decisions and determine optimal courses of action. AI itself is a subset of prescriptive analytics, requiring vast amounts of data and continual updates to enhance its learning capabilities, refine decision-making processes, and effectively communicate and execute decisions within a business framework. By combining these four analytics types, businesses can collectively enhance performance and drive success. What is AI analytics: At its core, AI involves the creation of algorithms that can process large volumes of data, recognize trends, and generate insights that would be difficult or impossible for humans to uncover manually. In data analysis, AI systems use techniques such as machine learning, natural language processing, and neural networks to interpret and make sense of complex data sets. By understanding the basics of AI in data analysis, businesses can leverage this technology to gain valuable insights, improve decision-making, and drive innovation in their operations. Benefits of AI analytics: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is revolutionizing the way data analysis is conducted, providing a wide array of benefits for businesses and organizations, including: AI ability to handle vast amounts of data at unprecedented speeds. AI algorithms can quickly process and analyze large datasets, uncovering valuable insights and patterns that may have otherwise gone unnoticed. This leads to more informed decision-making and a competitive edge in today's data-driven world. AI offers enhanced accuracy and precision in data analysis. By utilizing machine learning algorithms, AI can detect subtle trends and correlations within data that human analysts may overlook. This leads to more accurate predictions and recommendations, ultimately driving better business outcomes. AI-powered data analysis enables automation of repetitive tasks, freeing up human resources to focus on higher-value strategic initiatives. By automating data processing, cleansing, and analysis tasks, organizations can streamline their operations, improve efficiency, and reduce human error. AI facilitates real-time data analysis, allowing businesses to make timely decisions based on up-to-the-minute insights. This agility and responsiveness are crucial in today's fast-paced business environment, where quick decision-making can be the difference between success and failure. The benefits of using AI for data analysis are vast and impactful. From enhanced speed and accuracy to automation and real-time insights, AI is transforming the way organizations extract value from their data, driving innovation and competitive advantage. What’s the Difference between Traditional Analytics & AI Analytics: For years, traditional analytics has been the foundation of business intelligence, involving the collection of historical data, statistical analysis, and informed decision-making. While this method has its benefits, relying on set rules and static models, it also has its limitations. While traditional analytics is great for understanding past performance, it lacks the ability to predict future trends or recommend optimal actions. In today's fast-paced world, this retrospective view can put businesses at a disadvantage. On the other hand, artificial intelligence represents a revolutionary advancement in data-driven decision-making. Unlike traditional analytics, AI can analyze massive amounts of data in real-time, enabling businesses to uncover emerging patterns and trends that would be otherwise undetectable. This predictive power empowers organizations to proactively adjust to market changes. Use Cases for AI Analytics: Let’s review several use cases of AI analytics that nearly all businesses can benefit from: Fraud detection: By harnessing the power of artificial intelligence, businesses can proactively combat fraud by leveraging algorithms that analyze real-time data to identify and prevent potential threats. Unlike traditional fraud software, AI adapts its detection capabilities based on historical data, effectively thwarting emerging threats that may have previously gone undetected. Inventory Optimization: Through the integration of AI, machine learning, and optimization techniques, businesses can streamline their inventory management processes. This approach enables companies to strike a delicate balance between reducing inventory levels of components, raw materials, and finished products while ensuring that adequate stock is maintained to fulfill customer service agreements. Anti-Money Laundering: Anti-Money Laundering uses comprehensive machine learning techniques to increase the accurate detection of suspicious activity while significantly reducing false positive alerts. eCommerce Analytics: By using AI, ecommerce websites can personalize their customers' shopping experience by recommending products based on their purchase history, preferences, and behavior. Fintech Analytics: Companies in the financial sector can use AI to analyze and manage data from multiple sources to gain valuable insights. These innovative results help banks address the challenges they face daily in delivering everyday services such as payment processing. In Conclusion, from predicting trends and patterns to optimizing decision-making processes, AI is reshaping the way organizations leverage data to drive innovation and achieve operational excellence. Key points to note include: The application of AI to analytics presents capabilities that surpass what traditional data analysts can achieve, as traditional analytics typically require significant manual effort. Unlike traditional analytics, AI can analyze massive amounts of data in real-time, enabling businesses to uncover emerging patterns and trends that would be otherwise undetectable. By understanding the basics of AI in data analysis, businesses can leverage this technology to gain valuable insights, improve decision-making, and drive innovation in their operations.

slides.title: How does ChatGPT Work? The Inside Story of How OpenAI's AI Model Works
slides.subtitle: Dr. Sheik M. Isaacs, LSSBB, CSM, CSPO, CIMP 💻 on LinkedIn
slides.description: The world of artificial intelligence continues to evolve at a rapid pace, and one of the most intriguing advancements in this field is OpenAI's ChatGPT model. ChatGPT represents a significant step forward in natural language processing technology, allowing for more human-like interactions between machines and humans. In this article, we will delve into the inner workings of ChatGPT, exploring how this AI model was developed, the key features that set it apart, and the potential implications for the future of AI-driven communication. ChatGPT significance in AI: ChatGPT is a revolutionary AI model created by OpenAI, transforming conversational AI technology. This cutting-edge model is engineered to produce responses that mimic human conversation, enhancing the intuitiveness and engagement of interactions with AI systems. With its inventive structure and advanced training methods, ChatGPT can comprehend context, generate cohesive responses, and adjust to diverse conversational styles effortlessly. Its impact in the field of AI is profound, with the potential to redefine human-technology interactions and usher in a new era of personalized, interactive experiences across various applications. What is ChatGPT: ChatGPT is a powerful tool that combines conversational abilities with a large language model (LLM). The "Chat" part signifies its knack for engaging in conversations, while "GPT" represents the LLM that underpins the service. An LLM is an artificial intelligence that has been trained on vast amounts of data to generate and comprehend human-like text. With ChatGPT, anyone can tap into the LLM's capabilities by simply asking questions or providing prompts through a chatbot interface, regardless of their technical background. When it comes to the "GPT" aspect of ChatGPT, here's a brief overview: Generative, meaning the model can produce natural text based on user input; Pre-trained, as it has been fed a diverse array of data from sources like websites, social media, books, and articles to learn nuances of language; and Transformer, which refers to the neural network's ability to understand context and relationships within text. Development of the ChatGPT model: The dedicated team of researchers and engineers at OpenAI has put in extensive effort to craft a robust AI model capable of holding meaningful and coherent conversations with users. Through rigorous training on massive text datasets, the model has been equipped to comprehend and produce responses akin to human language. The training regimen focuses on instilling predictive capabilities in an artificial language model. Rather than scouring the internet for responses upon receiving a query, ChatGPT draws from its training data to provide accurate answers. The GPT model underwent a comprehensive two-step training process to enhance its accuracy and humanlike qualities. In the initial pre-training phase, ChatGPT was exposed to a vast dataset primarily sourced from the internet through the Common Crawl and WebText datasets. These datasets encompassed content from popular platforms such as Reddit, Twitter, Wikipedia, and wikiHow. By training on conversational data, ChatGPT developed the ability to generate responses similar to human speech patterns, enabling it to engage in realistic conversations. Following pre-training, the model underwent fine-tuning to address issues such as uncensored language and misinformation present in the training data. Human reviewers collaborated extensively with the model, providing feedback to refine its interactions and make them more trustworthy and personable. This fine-tuning process, known as Reinforcement Learning through Human Feedback (RLHF), further improved the model's performance. Link: 2e6c2f94-a539-4851-be8c-5b525c1e227c_2568x3462.png (2568×3462) (substackcdn.com) Key Features & Capabilities: ChatGPT is a fascinating AI model developed by OpenAI that has revolutionized the world of conversational AI. Some of its key features are its ability to engage in natural and coherent conversations with users, mimicking human-like responses effectively. This is made possible by the model's impressive language understanding capabilities, enabling it to generate contextually relevant responses. its scalability and adaptability. The model can be fine-tuned and customized to suit various use cases and industries, making it a versatile tool for developers and businesses looking to integrate conversational AI into their products and services. its advanced language generation capabilities, allowing it to produce high-quality and contextually appropriate responses across a wide range of topics. Its ability to understand nuances in language and generate coherent and engaging responses sets it apart from other AI models in the market. Overall, ChatGPT's key features and capabilities make it a powerful tool for creating engaging and interactive conversational experiences, driving innovation in the field of artificial intelligence and natural language processing. Implications & Future: ChatGPT holds immense potential across a wide array of applications, from customer service chatbots to educational aids and creative writing support. As ChatGPT undergoes further advancements and refinements, it stands poised to reshape our interactions with technology and one another. Looking ahead, the prospects for ChatGPT appear promising. With ongoing advances in AI technology, we can anticipate ChatGPT becoming even more sophisticated and adaptable. This evolution could pave the way for enriched communication experiences, customized interactions, and tailored solutions spanning various fields. Moreover, the ethical considerations surrounding AI models like ChatGPT will play a pivotal role in determining their societal integration and application. In summary, the introduction of ChatGPT marks a major achievement in AI advancement. By grasping its significance and contemplating its future possibilities, we can gain a deeper understanding of the potential influence of this groundbreaking technology on both our lives and society. Key points to note include: ChatGPT is an AI chatbot capable of producing and comprehending natural human language. Its knowledge base is sourced from an extensive dataset comprising billions of websites, books, journals, articles, and internet forums.

slides.title: AI Legal Landscape: Ownership, Copyright & Licensing of AI - Generated Content
slides.subtitle: Dr. Sheik M. Isaacs, LSSBB, CSM, CSPO, CIMP 💻 on LinkedIn
slides.description: With the ever-increasing prevalence of AI in our daily lives, it's no surprise that the legal landscape surrounding it is constantly evolving. This has led to a lot of confusion and uncertainty about the ownership and distribution of creative works that involve AI tools. In this article, we'll take a closer look at the legal implications of using AI in creative works, including ownership, copyright, and licensing. We'll also discuss some of the best practices for protecting your rights when producing AI-generated works. AI in the Creative Industry: With AI tools, artists can harness the power of technology to generate ideas, automate repetitive tasks, and explore new creative avenues. These tools can analyze vast amounts of data to provide insights, suggest improvements, and even predict trends in the creative landscape. By incorporating AI into their workflow, artists can augment their skills, boost productivity, and push the boundaries of traditional creative practices. However, as AI tools become increasingly prevalent in the creative industry, questions regarding ownership, copyright, and ethical considerations arise. Therefore, it is essential for artists and creators to navigate the legal landscape surrounding AI tools to protect their intellectual property rights and ensure ethical use of these technologies. Legal Considerations of using AI tools: AI has revolutionized the creative process by enhancing efficiency and offering new avenues for creativity. However, this advancement also brings about complex legal considerations that creators need to navigate. Legal Consideration #1: One key aspect to address is the ownership of the output generated by AI tools. Since AI operates based on algorithms and data inputs, determining who holds the rights to the final creative work can be challenging. It raises questions about whether the AI tool itself, the creator using the tool, or the entity that provided the tool should be credited as the owner of the work. Legal Consideration #2: Copyright laws may need to be reevaluated to encompass AI-generated content. The originality and authorship of works produced with AI assistance may blur traditional lines, requiring legal frameworks to adapt to this evolving landscape. Creators must be mindful of potential copyright infringement issues and ensure they have the necessary permissions to use AI tools for creative endeavors. Legal Consideration #3: Navigating the licensing and distribution of AI-created works requires a comprehensive understanding of intellectual property rights, legal frameworks, and ethical implications. While AI tools offer immense potential for enhancing creativity, creators must be vigilant about the legal implications associated with their use. By proactively addressing ownership, copyright, and licensing considerations, individuals can leverage AI technology responsibly and ethically in their creative pursuits. Ownership Rights & Intellectual Property: It is essential to establish clear ownership rights from the outset to avoid any legal disputes down the line. In many jurisdictions, copyright law governs ownership of creative works, but the application of these laws to AI-generated content is still evolving. Companies and individuals using AI tools must be vigilant in understanding the terms of use and licensing agreements associated with these tools. Some AI platforms may claim ownership of the content generated using their tools, while others may grant users full ownership rights. Additionally, it is crucial to consider the implications of using third-party content or data to train AI models. Ensuring that proper permissions and licenses are in place for any data used in the AI training process is essential to avoid infringing on the intellectual property rights of others. Navigating the legal landscape surrounding ownership rights and intellectual property considerations in the context of AI tools requires careful attention to detail and a proactive approach to safeguarding your rights and interests. By staying informed and seeking legal guidance, when necessary, content creators can harness the power of AI technology while protecting their intellectual property rights. Copyright Issues & Fair Use: When AI is used to generate content, such as articles, images, music, or videos, it raises the question of who owns the copyright to the output. In traditional copyright law, the creator of a work holds the copyright. However, with AI-generated content, the lines blur as the AI system itself is creating the work based on algorithms and data input by humans. Fair use, a doctrine that allows limited use of copyrighted material without permission for purposes such as criticism, comment, news reporting, teaching, scholarship, or research, also comes into play in the context of AI-generated content. Determining what constitutes fair use in this scenario can be challenging, as the process of creation and the role of human input in generating the content may vary. As the legal landscape continues to adapt to advancements in technology, it is essential for creators, users, and owners of AI-generated content to stay informed about copyright laws, fair use principles, and emerging regulations to navigate these issues effectively. Licensing & Distribution: Licensing AI-created works involves understanding the terms under which the generated content can be used, shared, or distributed. It is essential to establish clear agreements and licenses that outline the rights and responsibilities of all parties involved, including the AI creator, the user, and any intermediaries. Distribution of AI-generated content raises issues related to intellectual property rights and the protection of original works. Ensuring that proper licenses are in place can help protect against copyright infringement and unauthorized use of AI-generated materials. Furthermore, the emergence of AI technologies has prompted discussions around the attribution of creative works to their AI creators. Determining the rightful owner of AI-generated content requires careful consideration of existing copyright laws and ethical considerations. Best Practices for protecting your rights in AI-generated works: Protecting your rights in AI-generated works is crucial in the rapidly evolving digital landscape. As artificial intelligence becomes more prevalent in creating innovative and unique content, it is essential to establish best practices to safeguard your intellectual property rights. One of the key steps in protecting your rights in AI-generated works is to clearly define ownership and usage rights in your agreements. Ensure that contracts with AI developers or providers explicitly state who owns the rights to the generated content and how it can be used. This clarity can prevent disputes and legal issues down the line. Consider implementing robust security measures to safeguard your AI algorithms and data. Encryption, access controls, and regular security audits can help protect your proprietary technology from unauthorized access or misuse. Register your AI-generated works for copyright protection. While copyright laws may vary by jurisdiction, registering your works can provide you with legal recourse in case of infringement and strengthen your rights in the eyes of the law. Staying informed about the latest legal developments in AI and intellectual property law is essential. The landscape is continuously evolving, and being aware of changes can help you adapt your strategies to better protect your rights in AI-generated works. By following these best practices and taking proactive steps to protect your rights, you can navigate the legal challenges surrounding AI tools and creative works with confidence and ensure that your intellectual property remains secure. In conclusion, navigating the legal landscape in the creative industry requires a delicate balance between fostering innovation and ensuring legal compliance. As technology continues to advance, particularly with the integration of AI tools in creative processes, it is crucial for creators and businesses to stay informed about the legal implications and ownership rights associated with their works. Some of the key takeaways are: When it comes to Ownership Rights & Intellectual Property it is essential to establish clear ownership rights from the outset to avoid any legal disputes down the line. When it comes to Copyright Issues & Fair Use it is important to stay informed about copyright laws, fair use principles, and emerging regulations to navigate these issues effectively. When it comes to Licensing & Distribution determining the rightful owner of AI-generated content requires careful consideration. By embracing innovation while also being mindful of legal requirements, creators can protect their intellectual property and foster a culture of respect for copyrights and ownership.

slides.title: Empowering AI: The Power of Prompt Engineering
slides.subtitle: Dr. Sheik M. Isaacs, LSSBB, CSM, CSPO, CIMP 💻 on LinkedIn
slides.description: From Siri to Alexa, AI is changing the way we interact with technology. However, as AI technology advances, so do the demands on prompt engineering. Prompt engineering is a critical aspect of AI development and involves the creation and optimization of prompts to improve the accuracy and efficiency of AI systems. In this article, we will explore prompt engineering and how it empowers AI. We will cover the role of prompt engineering, how to create them, as well as the tools and techniques used in prompt engineering. Role of Prompt Engineering: Prompt engineering plays a crucial role in the development and optimization of AI systems. It involves crafting prompts or queries that effectively guide the AI model to generate the desired outputs or responses. Think of prompts as the input or instructions provided to AI systems to prompt them to perform specific tasks or generate specific outputs. Effective prompt engineering requires a deep understanding of the underlying AI model, its capabilities, and limitations. By carefully designing prompts, developers can shape the behavior and performance of AI systems, steering them towards more accurate and relevant outcomes. Prompt engineering is not just about formulating queries but also about fine-tuning them iteratively to improve the overall performance of the AI model. Through systematic experimentation and analysis, developers can refine prompts to enhance the output quality, minimize biases, and optimize the efficiency of AI systems. Creating an Effective Prompt: When designing prompts, it is essential to consider the context, intent, and desired outcome of the interaction. Clear and concise language is paramount to ensure that the AI system can accurately interpret and respond to the user's input. Additionally, incorporating relevant keywords and parameters into the prompt can help guide the AI system towards generating accurate and relevant outputs. When creating effective prompts for AI models is a crucial step in maximizing the performance and accuracy of your AI system. The foundation of any successful AI model lies in the quality of the prompts it receives. Here are some key strategies to consider when crafting prompts for your AI models: Clarity & Specificity: Ensure that your prompts are clear, concise, and specific to the desired outcome. Ambiguity in prompts can lead to misinterpretation by the AI model, resulting in inaccurate responses. Relevance to Task: Tailor your prompts to align with the specific task or goal of the AI model. The prompts should provide relevant context and information to guide the model towards the desired outcome. Consistency: Maintain consistency in the format and structure of your prompts to help the AI model learn and generalize patterns effectively. Consistent prompts enable the model to make connections and associations more efficiently. Variability and Diversity: Introduce variability and diversity in your prompts to expose the AI model to a wide range of inputs and scenarios. This helps enhance the model's adaptability and robustness in handling different types of data. Feedback Loop: Implement a feedback loop system to gather insights on the performance of your AI model based on the prompts provided. Analyzing the model's responses and adjusting prompts accordingly can help refine and improve its accuracy over time. By incorporating these strategies into your prompt engineering process, you can optimize the effectiveness and performance of your AI models, leading to more reliable and insightful outcomes. Case Studies: In the realm of prompt engineering, real-world case studies serve as invaluable sources of inspiration and learning. By exploring successful applications of prompt engineering, we gain insights into the power and potential of AI-driven solutions in diverse contexts. E-commerce: An e-commerce platform utilized prompt engineering to enhance personalized product recommendations for its users. By crafting tailored prompts based on user behavior and preferences, the platform achieved a significant increase in conversion rates and customer satisfaction. Healthcare: the utilization of prompt engineering to streamline patient triage processes. By developing intelligent prompts that guide healthcare professionals in assessing and prioritizing patient needs, hospitals were able to optimize resource allocation and improve overall patient outcomes. Tech: In the realm of virtual assistants, a prominent tech company leveraged prompt engineering to enhance the natural language processing capabilities of its AI-driven chatbot. Through meticulous prompt design and training, the chatbot was able to engage users more effectively, leading to higher user satisfaction and interaction rates. These case studies underscore the transformative impact of prompt engineering across various industries, showcasing how AI-powered prompts can drive innovation, efficiency, and customer engagement. By studying these successful applications, businesses and organizations can glean valuable insights to propel their own prompt engineering initiatives towards success. Tools & Resources for Prompting: When it comes to prompt engineering, having the right tools and resources at your disposal can make a significant difference in the quality and efficiency of your AI models. There are various tools available that can aid in prompt generation and refinement, helping you create prompts that are clear, concise, and tailored to your specific needs. One popular tool for prompt generation is OpenAI's GPT-3, which is a powerful language model that can generate text based on a given prompt. By leveraging GPT-3, you can quickly generate prompts for a wide range of applications, from content creation to chatbots. Other tools and resources that can assist in prompt refinement. Tools like TextBlob and SpaCy can help analyze and parse text, allowing you to fine-tune your prompts for better results. Furthermore, platforms like Hugging Face and DeepAI offer pre-trained models and libraries that can streamline the prompt engineering process. By utilizing these tools and resources effectively, you can enhance the performance of your AI models and create prompts that drive better outcomes. Experimenting with different tools and techniques can help you find the best approach for prompt generation and refinement in your AI projects. In conclusion, Prompt engineering is at the forefront of shaping the future of artificial intelligence (AI) and holds immense potential for driving AI advancement to new heights. By incorporating strategies into your prompt engineering process, you can optimize the effectiveness and performance of your AI models, leading to more reliable and insightful outcomes. Understanding real-world case studies serve as invaluable sources of inspiration and learning. Utilizing tools and resources can enhance the performance of your AI models and create prompts that drive better outcomes. By understanding the significance of prompt engineering and its impact on AI advancement, we can harness the full potential of artificial intelligence to create smarter, more efficient solutions that cater to the evolving needs of society.

publications.title: An Experimental Analysis of the Influence of Corporate Social Responsibility Initiatives on Beliefs, Attitudes and Behavioral Intentions within the Context of Corporate Credibility
publications.publishedAt: University of South Florida Theses and Dissertations Scholar Commons · Jan 1, 2008
publications.description:
Recently, the use of corporate social responsibility initiatives has grown in popularity and prominence among organizations as research increasingly suggests that these initiatives positively impact the corporation's bottom line. 

This study contributes to theory driven research in strategic communications by using an experimental design to test the influence of six distinct corporate social responsibility initiatives, as identified by Kotler and Lee (2005), on the beliefs, attitudes, and behavioral intention of message receivers, using Fishbein and Ajzen's (1975, 2005) theory of reasoned action as a theoretical framework. This study extends understanding of the Dual Credibility Model by examining the influence of corporate credibility as a belief set and mediator between organizations and their target publics.

This study is uniquely focused on developing a better understanding of how corporate social responsibility initiatives influence corporate credibility and corporate social responsibility beliefs. 

Findings do not indicate significant differences among corporate social responsibility initiatives. Only significant differences between using and not using an initiative were found. However, among the initiatives cause related marketing demonstrated the highest mean score, although not a significant difference. CSR initiatives do influence belief sets, specifically CSR beliefs. Exploratory research found that corporate credibility/trust and corporate credibility/expertise directly and significantly influenced behavioral intention toward the organization, suggesting an extension of the theory within the context of corporate credibility.

headline: Researcher (Ph.D. – International Development) | University of Birmingham (UK) | M.A. International Relations (The Fletcher School) | M.A. Global Affairs (University of Oklahoma)
about: I am an interdisciplinary scholar working at the intersection of urban governance, spatial justice, democratic resilience, and Black political subjectivity. My research integrates political theory, geography, development, and history to explain how communities negotiate power, resist authoritarianism, and construct new forms of identity and collective agency.I develop original theoretical and analytical frameworks that bridge scholarly inquiry with applied practice, including the Urban Insurgent Subjectivity (UIS) model, the Heritage Spatial Justice Index (HSJI), the Fear Resilience Index (FRI), the Democratic Opening Index (DOI), the Doctrine of No, and Pax Localis. These frameworks aim to measure political openings, map spatial inequality, analyze authoritarian backsliding, and illuminate how cities and marginalized communities generate forms of autonomy, refusal, and transformation. My work has been field-tested with civic and heritage institutions across the United States and has informed ongoing collaborations related to governance, memory politics, sovereignty, and urban inequality. I bring methodological range—archival research, political theory, fieldwork, index construction, and spatial analysis—to questions of race, democracy, and human development.I hold an M.A. in International Relations from The Fletcher School of Law and Diplomacy (Tufts University), an M.A. in Global Affairs from the University of Oklahoma, and am completing my PhD in International Development at the University of Birmingham. My commentary and research appear in The Fletcher Forum of World Affairs, Georgetown Security Studies Review, The Africa Report, and Eagle Intelligence Reports. As an author and public thinker, I am committed to advancing work that is analytically rigorous, ethically grounded, and deeply connected to the lived realities of the African and African diasporic experience. I welcome collaboration with scholars, policymakers, heritage institutions, urban governance teams, and organizations seeking innovative frameworks and data-driven approaches to building more resilient, equitable futures.

projects.title: "Beyond Borders: Examining Political, Economic, and Social Implications of the Proposed Confederation in Burkina Faso, Mali, and Niger through Neofunctionalism, Intergovernmentalism, and Regionalism Perspectives."
projects.description:
This case study investigates the application of neo-functionalism, intergovernmentalism, and regionalism theories to the proposed confederation between Burkina Faso, Mali, and Niger, aiming to discern the potential political, economic, and social implications for the region. Against the backdrop of increasing regional integration efforts worldwide, the study seeks to contribute nuanced insights into the dynamics of a prospective confederation and its impact on the participating nations.
The research employs a mixed-methods approach, combining qualitative content analysis of historical documents, policy frameworks, and official statements with quantitative assessments of economic indicators, political stability measures, and social development indices. The analytical framework is designed to explore the mechanisms through which neo-functionalism, intergovernmentalism, and regionalism manifest in the proposed confederation and to assess their respective influences on political structures, economic policies, and social dynamics within the region.

The investigation is structured around three primary objectives:
1.	Neofunctionalism and Political Integration:
•	Analyzing the potential role of neo-functionalism in shaping political integration within the proposed confederation.
•	Examining how supranational institutions and shared policy objectives may contribute to developing common political frameworks.
2.	Intergovernmentalism and Economic Implications:
•	Investigating the intergovernmentalist perspective on economic cooperation within the confederation.
•	Assessing the impact of national interests, state sovereignty, and bilateral agreements on economic policies and trade relations.
3.	Regionalism and Social Dynamics:
•	Exploring the regionalist dimension in social dynamics, cultural exchange, and human development.
•	Analyzing the potential influence of shared regional identity on social cohesion and collaboration.

projects.title: Black Global Visionaries Podcast
projects.description: Welcome to "Black Global Visionaries," your passport to a podcast that brilliantly amplifies the voices and perspectives of the Black community, both locally and globally. In each episode, we embark on an exploration of an array of topics, delving into cultural triumphs, tackling societal challenges within the Pan-African experience, and seamlessly weaving through the intersection of Black narratives with global issues. Our platform is a stage for insightful conversations with thought leaders, changemakers, and experts who bring a unique depth of understanding to the dynamic tapestry of the Black experience worldwide. From the roots of the African diaspora to the farthest corners of the globe, "Black Global Visionaries" is committed to fostering understanding, celebrating diversity, and empowering our community through stories that transcend borders. Each episode peels back another layer of the rich tapestry that is the global Black experience. Whether you seek knowledge, inspiration, or a deeper connection with the world, "Black Global Visionaries" promises to be your gateway to a diverse and empowered perspective. Tune in, stay informed, and actively participate in the conversation. Because when Black voices unite on a global scale, the vision becomes clear, and the impact is profound. "Black Global Visionaries" is not just a podcast; it's a dynamic space where our stories converge to shape the world.

projects.title: Decolonizing Democracy: Reevaluating Governance in Africa through an Indigenous Lens
projects.description:
"Decolonizing Democracy: Reevaluating Governance in Africa through an Indigenous Lens" by Curtis Smith is a groundbreaking exploration of African governance, meticulously unfolding across eleven chapters. Smith meticulously traces the historical legacy of colonial rule and its impact on the current democratic landscape in Africa. publications.title: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Democracy
publications.description:
In "A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Democracy," Curtis Smith navigates the intricate political topography of Africa, challenging traditional democratic and economic paradigms. Examining the complex interplay of neo-functionalism, regionalism, and intergovernmentalism, the book elucidates how African nations chart distinctive governance trajectories, diverging from Western democratic models.
Focusing on China's ascendancy as a non-democratic economic powerhouse, the narrative underscores the paradoxical success and prompts a theoretical exploration of alternative governance structures aligned with Africa's cultural richness. Smith strategically draws parallels between China's trajectory and the latent potential within African nations, advocating for innovative models reflective of the continent's cultural heritage.
By interrogating the principles of global economic liberalism and critiquing the foundations of the liberal global economic order, the book challenges conventional wisdom. Illuminating China's deviation from democratic and free-market norms, it advocates for a reconsideration of theoretical frameworks and encourages African nations to explore unconventional paths to economic prosperity.
In a world where democracy and free-market ideologies are conventionally intertwined, this work offers a scholarly perspective, prompting readers to contemplate the prospect of African nations forging distinctive destinies through avant-garde and culturally grounded approaches to governance and economic development. This insightful exploration initiates a crucial discourse on the future of democracy and economic systems within Africa and their broader implications.

publications.title: The Africa That Can Say No
publications.description:
"The Africa That Can Say No" is a thought-provoking exploration of Africa's potential to assert its independence on the global stage. In this visionary book, the author delves into the idea that African nations can break free from external influences and take charge of their own destinies. The narrative unfolds as a compelling argument for continent-wide political and economic integration, proposing the establishment of a Central Bank and a single currency as crucial steps towards fostering unity.
With an insightful analysis, the book underscores how Africa's burgeoning population growth positions the continent as a potential giant in the global marketplace. As the book unfolds, readers are taken on a journey through Africa's vast and rich resources, demonstrating the untapped wealth that could redefine the continent's economic landscape. The author encourages a paradigm shift, urging African nations to harness their collective strength and leverage their resources for sustainable development.
"The Africa That Can Say No" is not just a call for autonomy; it's a strategic roadmap for a future where Africa emerges as a formidable player in the international arena. This groundbreaking work challenges conventional narratives and inspires a reimagining of Africa's role in shaping its own narrative, one where the continent stands tall and asserts its right to say no to external pressures from major global powers.

publications.title: Beacon Technologies: The Hitchhiker's Guide to The Beacosystem
publications.description:
Proximity technology—in particular, Bluetooth beacons—is a major source of business opportunity, and this book provides everything you need to know to architect a solution to capitalize on that opportunity. Learn the key standards—iBeacon, Eddystone, Bluetooth 4.0, and AltBeacon—and how they work with other proximity technologies. Then build your understanding of the proximity framework and how to identify and deploy the best solutions for your own business, institutional, or consulting needs.

Solutions architects of all types—venture capitalists, founders, CEOs, strategists, product managers, CTOs, business developers, and programmers—will learn about the following from reading Beacon Technologies: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Beacosystem:

- The disruptive implications of digital–physical convergence and the new applications it makes possible
- The key standards that solutions developers need to understand to capitalize on the business opportunity of proximity technology
- The new phenomenon of beacon networks, which will be hugely significant in driving strategic decisions and creating wealth
- Other technologies in the proximity ecosystem catalyzed by and complementary to Bluetooth beacons, including visual light communication, magnetic resonance, and RFID
- The Beacosystem framework for analyzing the proximity ecosystem

about:
I am thrilled to cover Transportation Equipment & Shipping in sell-side equity research at Citigroup:
- Locomotive Manufacturing & Servicing: Wabtec (WAB).
- River/Coastal Barge Operator & Power Generator Manufacturing/Distribution/Servicing: Kirby (KEX).
- Truck Leasing & Supply Chain Management/Dedicated Trucking: Ryder (R).
- Railcar & Aircraft Engine Leasing: GATX (GATX).

I also cover the fascinating sector that is Transportation:
- Freight Railroads: Union Pacific (UNP), CSX (CSX), Norfolk Southern (NSC), Canadian National (CNI), Canadian Pacific (CP).
- Airfreight/Parcels: United Parcel Service (UPS), FedEx (FDX).
- Truckload/Intermodal: JB Hunt (JBHT), Knight-Swift (KNX), Werner (WERN), Schneider (SNDR).
- Less-than-Truckload: Old Dominion (ODFL), Saia (SAIA), XPO (XPO), TFI International (TFII), ArcBest (ARCB).
- Logistics (Freight Brokerage, Warehousing): CH Robinson (CHRW), RXO (RXO), GXO (GXO).

These companies are involved in moving the essential goods that drive the U.S. and world economies, including foods & beverages; consumer products such as electronics, apparel, and furniture; autos & auto parts; grains; energy; metals; chemicals; forest products such as lumber and paper; and highly time-sensitive packages and documents.

At Citigroup, my team ranked #1 in stock picks by Bloomberg. Before joining Citigroup, I covered transportation and shipping at Deutsche Bank, where my team ranked #1 in broker votes, #3 (on track to #2) in the transportation category, and #2 (on track to #1) in the shipping category of the annual Institutional Investor survey. Prior to that, I covered transportation at Credit Suisse, where my team ranked #1 in stock picks by Bloomberg. Previously, I spent 12 years on the buy-side and started my career in investment banking at Jefferies. I hold an MBA in finance & accounting from the University of Chicago and a BS in economics from Caltech, and am a CFA charterholder. Born in Vancouver, Canada, and raised in Los Angeles, I live in Manhattan with my wife and son.

headline: Lead Data Analyst - Quantitative Risk at Citi®
about:
Well-rounded Data professional with 10 years of experience and a strong foundation in Business Analysis, Data Engineering, Data Science, and product management.

On a personal level, I am detail-oriented, organized, and precise in my work. I have strong communication skills and a knack for clear and illuminating presentations. With the industries moving towards being data-driven, my current focus is on data analytics, big data, and machine Learning in Python to develop dynamic solutions for clients.

Specialties:
- Statistics - Green Belt certified Six Sigma expert
- Data Analysis using R, Python, and Excel
- Data Visualization - Tableau Certified Desktop Specialist - Tableau Profile
- AWS Certified Solution Architect
- Project Management (CSM, Prince2 Certified Practitioner)

Skill-set	
- Languages: SQL, Python (Pandas, NumPy, Regex, SciPy, Scikit-learn), R, PL/SQL,
- Big Data: Hive, Hadoop, MapReduce, Spark, PySpark, AWS (S3, EC2, EMR),
- Databases: Oracle, MySQL, Sybase, PostgreSQL, DB2, Cassandra, Microsoft SQL Server, ETL
- Machine Learning: Linear & Logistic Regression, Classification, Clustering, Hypothesis testing
- Data Visualization: Tableau, R (ggplot2, Shiny), SAS GChart, Matplotlib, Excel (Pivot Table, V-Lookup)
- Other Tools: RStudio, SAS Enterprise Miner, Weka, Informatica, Putty, SQL Developer

experience.description:
•Establishing near real-time data ingestion and processing pipeline to provide clean, complete data and augment the modeling framework

•Defining and monitoring KRIs for peer analysis, and trends, and assisting in developing management reporting. 
•Providing an independent opinion and assessment of any future funding needs using tools such as liquidity buffer sizing, liquidity stress testing (LST), and other regulatory metrics such as LCR and NSFR
•Compliance with Model Risk and Vetting requirements by conducting necessary tests, packaging implementation summary tests, and results

-	Conducting statistical analysis and data cleansing on large databases through sophisticated econometric software coding
-	Aggregating clean datasets from multiple sources to provide a comprehensive assessment using SQL/Python
-	Creating analytical dashboards with Tableau, to share model results, forecasts credit risk trends, and variances from expectations
-	Using Predictive modeling methods, optimizing monitoring systems, document optimization solutions, and presenting results 
-	Drafting model documentation using statistical vocabulary and validation reports which focus on the following model types: Retail (e.g., mortgages, credit cards, auto loans), wholesale risk & credit risk models, based on PD/LGD/EAD models

- Worked as a teaching assistant for Business Application Development in C# using object-oriented programming concepts at the department of Information Systems and Decision Sciences
- Mentored undergrad students in Business Application Development in C# and Data Analytics in Python
- Guided the students in their respective projects and prepare prior research work

- Provided recommendations and predictive analysis to the higher management on improving strategies using Tableau & Einstein Analytics
- Developed Salesforce console configuration, workflows with validation rules, process builder(ETL pipelines), visual flow, security & role hierarchy settings

- Articulated a clear, consistent, and creative value proposition in data analytics for our target markets, while acting as the linchpin between our Data analytics and product teams
- Developed end-to-end data solutions, and worked with cross-functional stakeholders to identify opportunities and recommend prioritization of product, growth, and optimization initiative
- Analyzed, Designed, and developed Data discovery dashboards in Tableau to present the data story to the business stakeholders.
- Created SQL scripts to populate tables in the data warehouse to automate daily reporting across the department

- Built ETLs, pipelines, and automation to ensure we can understand and act on business performance accurately, scalably, with low latency, and minimal manual upkeep
- Spearheaded a team to analyze and develop a re-usable process for automating product game demos for the client, saving 40man-hrs per month and reducing run-time by 30%
- Developed methodologies to improve the in-game customer experience such as predicting when users are likely to perform certain actions, churn or monetize. Use predictive analytics to predict how users will react to changes in the games

- Architected and implemented analytics and visualisation components for device data analysis platform to predict hardware
- Developed different types of Tableau reports by working on the data model to fit tableau needs and discovering data by tableau to best answer the business questions.

- Curated analytical monthly and quarterly reports using complex marketing databases on ELOQUA, maintained ETL mappings using Informatica and created trend analysis across regions using Google Analytics
- Designed and executed internal/external marketing campaigns for lateral sourcing requirements
- Prepared and presented detailed analysis, case studies and analytical reports to senior management (including the CEO, CIO & MD)

- Worked closely with Marketing, Sales and IT to ensure that the data flows through various processes and systems accurately
- Conducted competitive research on the market and analyze benchmarking data
- Contributed to the overall reporting metrics for data management dashboards
- Managed day to day responsibilities of the Data Steward Team in India

projects.title: Classification of Hate Tweets with GAN and RNN based  Data Generation using Python
projects.associatedWith: Associated with University of South Florida Muma College of Business
projects.description:
This is an Academic group project(Text Analytics course)

Hate speech classification algorithms tend to underperform because the hate tweets are much less in numbers.

We proposed two innovative approaches to deal with this class imbalance problem where we have artificially enhanced the number of hate tweets in our dataset. 

In our first approach we synthetically generated document vectors having the characteristics of hateful conducts using Generative Adversarial Nets(GAN) and this led to significant performance improvement of the classifier thereby giving us as high as 89% precision. 

In the second approach we generated hate tweets using Recurrent Neural Network(RNN) based text generation and subsequently fed them to the classifier leading to 88% precision in detection.
